events.title: The AJ’s Anomaly Demo Is Live for Steam Next Fest!

events.title: The new AJ's Anomaly third person patch is here!
events.summary: The anomaly hunting gameplay mode has now been placed as a sub game mode within AJ's apartment. It's a therapy device assigned by Dr Cid from Alter Evo.A lot has changed with this build but most of it will be brand new to you. Our third person mode is very similar to the base gameplay in Alter Evo. Walk around rooms, interact with objects, listen to characters talk and hear their thoughts. events.title: AJ's Anomaly Playtest is Here
events.summary: Hey everyone, it's Leon from Technical Fiction.AJ's Anomaly is now available for playtesting. If you're reading this, you're lucky because you have access to the full game. What can you expect gameplay wise? AJ's Anomaly is very similar to Exit 8, you memorize a room and visit it over and over again looking for differences from the base setup.
